name: Narrow Grip Wall Push-Up
how_to:
Setup
- Stand facing a wall, about 1 to 2 feet away, depending on your comfort level and strength.
- Place your hands on the wall at chest height, slightly closer than shoulder-width apart.
- Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Execution
- Starting Position: With your arms straight but not locked, maintain a neutral neck and spine.
- Lowering Phase: Slowly bend your elbows, keeping them close to your body as your chest moves toward the wall.
- Pause: Stop when your elbows form a 90-degree angle or as close as you can comfortably go.
- Pushing Phase: Push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
- Repeat: Perform for the desired number of repetitions with controlled motion.
Tips for Maximum Effectiveness
- Progress Gradually: Start closer to the wall and increase the distance as you build strength.
- Engage the Core: Tighten your abs throughout the movement to prevent arching or sagging.
- Control Your Breathing: Inhale as you lower toward the wall and exhale as you push back to the starting position.
- Combine with Other Exercises: Pair with traditional push-ups or dips for a comprehensive upper-body workout.
